name: a11y-workbench
description: A browser-local accessibility report workbench and synthetic pattern lab, in development.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @a11y-workbench/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @a11y-workbench/core && npm run build -w @a11y-workbench/cli
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @a11y-workbench/web && node --import tsx scripts/indexing-artifacts.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.build:pages: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/a11y-workbench SITE_RELEASE_APPROVED=false SITE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN= npm run build && node scripts/static-notices.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts tests playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx --test --test-isolation=none tests/core/*.test.ts tests/cli/*.test.ts tests/content/*.test.ts tests/security/*.test.ts tests/seo/*.test.ts
scripts.check:security: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx --test --test-isolation=none tests/core/*.test.ts tests/cli/*.test.ts tests/security/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:seo && npm run check:licenses && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:a11y
